question:
The following sentence has been divided into three segments. One of them may contain an adverbial usage error. Select the option that has the segment with the error. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.

Mr. Narayanan / is a rather / lazy man.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence provided is:** "Mr. Narayanan is a rather lazy man."**
 
• There is **no adverbial usage error in any segment of the sentence.**
 
• **The sentence is grammatically correct as it stands.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is "**No error**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mr. Narayanan** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **is a rather** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **lazy man** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This is the correct option as there are no errors in the sentence.
